Looks can be deceiving.
Aug 2026 • Friends
The meal started off well but, quickly went downhill. The entre was missing some ingredients. Then, we had to wait 45 minutes for the main course because they'd served another table before us. Again it was missing it's side dish. After the main was cleared we had to wait another 30 minutes for our dessert. When we finally asked for the bill. It didn't arrive at all. We had to go the cashier to pay. There were issues with that as well. We couldn't get out of there quick enough except we couldn't due to all the issues we had. I don't recommend this restaurant unless you want to waste several hours. They are very disorganised. It's a shame because the food that we received was lovely. They need a manager who knows how to organise service better.

My favorite restaurant.
Oct 2025 • Business
Here everything was perfect with all the details and the service of the staff. Ban friendly and attentive, always watching and caring for customers from far away, full of natural comfort and kindness. Replace fork and spoon regularly.
For me, dinner tastes perfect and professional, and is worth enough for the dinner I paid for.
Here is a set menu. But that day, I chose a simple menu because I wanted to choose the dishes I most liked before coming here. In fact, there are many aptitudes here.Very carefully delivered... I didn't think of so much cooking. Very interesting as a guide to enjoy the taste of each stage here. When I had all of the dessert I ordered, the restaurant served a tray with delicate, beautiful tea and cake, the last step of dinner.
